title: Rising & Trending Repos Finder for GitHub
description: Find rising and trending repositories, search repositories, or look up a list of repositories using the official GitHub REST API. Repository data only. Unofficial tool, not affiliated with GitHub.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: rising = new repositories that gained the most stars (approximates trending with the official Search API). search = keyword / qualifier search. repos = look up a list of repositories.
enumTitles: Look up a list of repositories

createdWithinDays.title: Created within the last N days (rising mode)
createdWithinDays.description: Rising mode looks for repositories created in this window, sorted by stars.

minStars.title: Minimum stars
minStars.description: Used in rising and search modes.

maxStars.title: Maximum stars (search mode)
maxStars.description: Upper star limit in search mode. Leave empty for no limit.

language.title: Programming language
language.description: GitHub language name, for example Python, TypeScript, Rust. Leave empty for all languages.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Repository topics, for example llm, game-engine. All listed topics must match.

query.title: Keywords (search mode)
query.description: Free-text keywords searched in repository name, description and topics. GitHub search qualifiers are allowed except user: (to avoid building per-person lists); use org: for organizations.

createdAfter.title: Created on or after (search mode)
createdAfter.description: Only repositories created on or after this date. Absolute (2026-01-01) or relative (30 days).

pushedAfter.title: Last pushed on or after (search mode)
pushedAfter.description: Only repositories with a push on or after this date, to skip inactive projects.

sort.title: Sort by
sort.description: Sort order for rising and search modes. best-match uses GitHub relevance.

includeForks.title: Include forks
includeForks.description: Include forked repositories in search results.

repositories.title: Repositories (repos mode)
repositories.description: One per line: owner/name or https://github.com/owner/name.

maxRepos.title: Max repositories
maxRepos.description: Cost cap. Each repository row is one billed repo event. The GitHub Search API returns at most 1,000 results per query.

enrich.title: Add enriched fields (requires your token)
enrich.description: Adds latest release, README presence/size and count of open issues with bounty labels. Needs a GitHub token. Billed as repo-enriched per repository.

bountyLabels.title: Bounty labels to count (enriched)
bountyLabels.description: Open issues carrying any of these labels are counted in bountyIssueCount (case-insensitive). Only counts are returned, never issue titles or authors.

githubToken.title: Your GitHub token (optional)
githubToken.description: Fine-grained personal access token with read-only access to public repositories. Raises GitHub rate limits and is required for enriched fields. Stored encrypted, never logged or shared, used only for this run's API calls.
